note: Machine-readable encoding of the authority policy. The agent (agent/policy_engine.py) reads THIS to decide what it may do on its own. If the policy changes, this file changes — the agent's classification code does not.
default_reason: Policy 6.1: where it is unclear whether an action falls within section 3, it is to be treated as though it does.

autonomous_actions.description: Read a referral from the overnight queue.
Retrieve a resident's history, household composition, and case events.
Draft a triage note for caseworker review. Has no effect on the case until adopted.
Record that a referral has been read and triaged.
Flag a referral for human attention, including as urgent.
Identify an out-of-authority action and escalate it under section 4.

restricted_actions.label: entitlement_or_eligibility_change
restricted_actions.description: Any change to a resident's entitlement, award amount, or eligibility status.

restricted_actions.label: award_status_change
restricted_actions.description: Suspension, termination, or reinstatement of an award.

restricted_actions.label: payment_initiation_or_cancellation
restricted_actions.description: Initiation, alteration, or cancellation of a payment.

restricted_actions.label: payment_details_change
restricted_actions.description: Any change to payment details, including bank or card details.
triggers: account into which payment is made

restricted_actions.label: resident_or_third_party_communication
restricted_actions.description: Any communication sent to a resident or to a third party.

restricted_actions.label: external_disclosure
restricted_actions.description: Disclosure of resident information to any party outside the Department.

restricted_actions.label: conduct_finding
restricted_actions.description: Creation of a record asserting a finding of fact about a resident's conduct (incl. suspected fraud).

restricted_actions.label: irreversible_action
restricted_actions.description: Any action which, once taken, cannot be reversed by the Department acting alone.

household_restrictions.label: minor_in_household_no_draft
household_restrictions.description: Drafting a triage note is not permitted where the household includes a person under the age of 18. Unlike restricted_actions, this is evaluated from the resident's household composition, not from the referral's requested_action or summary text.
household_restrictions.on_composition_unknown_reason: Amendment ACA-2026/2, clause 5.2: where household composition cannot be established, 3.9 is to be treated as applying, in accordance with policy 6.1.
household_restrictions.not_an_escalation_reason: Amendment ACA-2026/2, clause 3.3: a hand-off under 3.2 is not an escalation under section 4 and must be distinguishable from one.
